mapper.insert: insert into after_sale_request(request_no, order_id, user_id, request_type, reason, status, previous_order_status, reviewed_by, review_reason, reviewed_at, refund_no, create_time, update_time) values(#{requestNo},#{orderId},#{userId},#{requestType},#{reason},#{status},#{previousOrderStatus}, #{reviewedBy},#{reviewReason},#{reviewedAt},#{refundNo},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from after_sale_request where id=#{id} for update
select * from after_sale_request where order_id=#{orderId} and status in ('PENDING','APPROVED','REFUND_PROCESSING','REFUND_FAILED') order by id desc limit 1
select * from after_sale_request where order_id=#{orderId} and user_id=#{userId} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update after_sale_request set status=#{status}, reviewed_by=#{reviewedBy}, review_reason=#{reviewReason}, reviewed_at=#{reviewedAt}, update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and status='PENDING'
update after_sale_request set status=#{status}, refund_no=coalesce(#{refundNo}, refund_no), update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and status=#{expectedStatus}
update after_sale_request set status=#{status}, update_time=#{updateTime} where refund_no=#{refundNo} and status in ('REFUND_PROCESSING','REFUND_FAILED','APPROVED')
